title: usage-record.v1
description: One model call attempt, or one response-cache hit that avoided a call. Content-free: no prompt, response or reasoning text. See ATTRIBUTION.md for field semantics. Additive changes bump the minor in schema_version and keep this major; removed or re-meant fields bump the major and the $id. Merge key across producers: (producer.name, record_id). Enum-valued fields may gain values in a minor: readers must treat an unknown value as opaque, not as an error (ATTRIBUTION.md, reader rule).

schema_version.description: Major is fixed by this schema; minor counts additive changes.

record_id.description: Unique within a producer: '<call_id>:<attempt>' (attempt 0 for a cache hit). Two producers may collide, so the merge/idempotency key is (producer.name, record_id); a duplicate delivery of the same key is the same record. Referenced by complete-json-call.v1.

kind.description: model_call: one physical provider attempt. cache_hit: a response cache answered; billed tokens are zero and saved_* say what it avoided.

call_id.description: One logical call; every attempt of it shares this id.

attempt.description: 1-based physical attempt of the logical call; 0 for a cache hit.

consumer.description: The program or product on whose behalf the call ran (awork, awork-resume, gateway, rsi-harness). The literal 'unattributed' marks a defect.

agent.description: Agent name (kernel agent spec name, or a pipeline actor).

session.description: Session or run id: a chat session key, a build id, a rollout id.

role.description: Functional role of the call (maker, checker, extractor, judge...).

purpose.description: Task type or stage name (extract_claims, fluff_check).

slot.description: Schema slot being filled, when the call serves one.

tags.description: Host-defined extras. Never the carrier of consumer, agent, session or role. Producer limits (not validated here, so a reader never rejects a record for them): at most 16 keys of at most 64 characters, scalar values, strings at most 120 characters, 2 KiB serialised. A value that does not fit is dropped, not clipped, and the producer sets the key moeka.tags_truncated to true. Content (prompts, replies, names of people) does not belong in tags.

parent_call_id.description: call_id of the logical call that caused this one (sub-agent, verifier).

request_key.description: Cache/replay key of the request (opaque; see complete-json-call.v1 key_scheme).

key_scheme.description: How request_key was derived (awr.sha256.v1, moeka.request_key.v1, or your own '<name>.v<N>'). Two request_keys are comparable only under the same scheme; a different scheme can never match, so a cross-producer 'same request' analysis must say which scheme it joined on. null when request_key is null.

prompt_version.description: Caller's version label of the prompt template.

alias.description: Host-side model alias or preset name.

tokens_in.description: Billed input tokens, INCLUDING cache reads and cache writes (a provider that reports them separately, as Anthropic does, is normalised by adding them in). Zero on a cache hit.

tokens_out.description: Billed output tokens, INCLUDING reasoning tokens always: a provider that reports reasoning outside its output count (a total above input plus output) is normalised by adding the excess here. Zero on a cache hit.

tokens_cache_read.description: Subset of tokens_in served from the provider prompt cache; null = not reported.

tokens_cache_write.description: Subset of tokens_in written to the provider prompt cache; null = not reported.

tokens_reasoning.description: Hidden reasoning tokens, a SUBSET of tokens_out (never added to it again); null = not reported.

usage_source.description: Whether the provider billed these counts or the producer estimated them.

cost_usd.description: USD cost of this record; null = unknown (never free by default). 0 on a cache hit.

cost_billed.description: True when cost_usd is ground truth (provider-reported usage at a known price, or the local-zero convention).

price_source.description: cache: a response cache answered, cost is zero by construction. provider_reported: the provider returned the cost. price_table: tokens times the producer's price table. local_zero: local tier convention. none: no price known (cost_usd null).

cache_hit.description: A response cache answered; no provider call was made.

saved_tokens_in.description: Input tokens a cache hit avoided; null when not a hit or unknown.

saved_tokens_out.description: Output tokens a cache hit avoided.

saved_cost_usd.description: USD a cache hit avoided (original call's cost); null when unknown.

outcome.description: ok: usable result. truncated: hit the token limit. parse_failure: replied but not valid for the schema. error/timeout/cancelled: the attempt failed.

error_kind.description: Provider/transport error class when outcome is error or timeout.

waste_label.description: Why THESE tokens did not contribute to the final result. retry: this attempt was superseded by a later attempt of the same call (the retry that produced the answer is not waste). Set on the record when known at emission, or by a linked waste-label.v1 document keyed by (call_id, attempt) that readers apply (a retry is only known after the attempt ended).

producer.description: Software that emitted the record (moeka, awr.llm).
